description: Source code for handling git refspec parsing, validation, matching, and application functions.

methods.name: parse_refspec
methods.description: Parses a refspec string into a refspec_item structure, validating format and patterns.

methods.name: refspec_item_init
methods.description: Initializes a refspec_item with a refspec string and fetch flag.

methods.name: refspec_item_init_fetch
methods.description: Initializes a refspec_item for fetch operation.

methods.name: refspec_item_init_push
methods.description: Initializes a refspec_item for push operation.

methods.name: refspec_item_clear
methods.description: Clears and frees resources associated with a refspec_item.

methods.name: refspec_init_fetch
methods.description: Initializes a refspec structure for fetch.

methods.name: refspec_init_push
methods.description: Initializes a refspec structure for push.

methods.name: refspec_append
methods.description: Appends a refspec string to a refspec structure.

methods.name: refspec_appendf
methods.description: Appends a formatted refspec string to a refspec structure.

methods.name: refspec_appendn
methods.description: Appends multiple refspec strings to a refspec structure.

methods.name: refspec_clear
methods.description: Clears all refspec items from a refspec structure.

methods.name: valid_fetch_refspec
methods.description: Validates a fetch refspec string.

methods.name: refspec_ref_prefixes
methods.description: Extracts reference prefixes from refspecs, considering patterns and negations.

methods.name: match_refname_with_pattern
methods.description: Matches a refname against a pattern with optional replacement.

methods.name: refname_matches_negative_refspec_item
methods.description: Checks if a refname matches any negative refspec item.

methods.name: refspec_find_negative_match
methods.description: Finds if a refname matches any negative refspecs in a refspec list.

methods.name: refspec_find_all_matches
methods.description: Finds all refnames matching a query refspec in a refspec list.

methods.name: refspec_find_match
methods.description: Finds a match for a query refspec in a refspec list, returning the matching refname.

methods.name: apply_negative_refspecs
methods.description: Removes refs matching negative refspecs from a ref list.

methods.name: apply_refspecs
methods.description: Applies refspecs to a ref name to produce a destination ref name.
